blocks.en: Validation Criteria: Limit of Quantification, Linearity, Range, Ruggedness, Robustness, Method Suitability and Comparability

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Limit of Quantification (LoQ) 如何從 accuracy 或 linearity 研究推導，並掌握以 Poisson 分佈與 99% 下限信賴界限決定 LoQ 的統計邏輯
blocks.en: Understand how the Limit of Quantification (LoQ) is derived from the accuracy or linearity study, and master the statistical logic of determining the LoQ using the Poisson distribution and the 99% lower confidence limit

blocks.zh: 掌握 Linearity（線性）的兩種評估角度（絕對讀數 vs. 相對讀數）與其對應的迴歸分析判定準則（斜率、截距、R²、適合度檢定）
blocks.en: Master the two ways of evaluating Linearity (absolute readings vs. relative readings) and the corresponding regression analysis criteria (slope, intercept, R2, goodness-of-fit test)

blocks.zh: 理解 Range（範圍）如何直接沿用 accuracy、repeatability、linearity 的既有數據，而非另立新試驗
blocks.en: Understand how Range directly reuses the existing data of accuracy, repeatability and linearity instead of requiring a new study

blocks.zh: 掌握 Ruggedness（堅牢性）的 ANOVA 隨機效應模型與相對標準差（RSD）五步驟計算法，並能依 Table 5.4.8.3-1 判讀不同 CFU 範圍的可接受 RSD
blocks.en: Master the ANOVA random-effects model and the five-step relative standard deviation (RSD) calculation for Ruggedness, and be able to read the acceptable RSD for different CFU ranges from Table 5.4.8.3-1

blocks.zh: 理解 Robustness（耐用性）如何評估關鍵參數（試劑濃度、環境條件、儀器操作極限）微幅變動對方法表現的影響
blocks.en: Understand how Robustness evaluates the effect of small variations in critical parameters (reagent concentration, environmental conditions, instrument operating limits) on method performance

blocks.zh: 掌握 Method Suitability（方法適用性）中偽陽性/偽陰性測試設計，以及如何與後續 Comparability（可比性）研究銜接，建立 AMM/RMM 導入的完整統計驗證邏輯鏈
blocks.en: Master the design of false-positive/false-negative tests in Method Suitability and how it connects to the subsequent Comparability study, building the complete statistical validation logic chain for AMM/RMM implementation

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Limit of Quantification（LoQ，定量極限）：在既定實驗條件下，可以「可接受的準確度與精密度」被計數的微生物最低數量。這與前一節提到的 LoD（偵測極限，Limit of Detection）不同——LoD 只問「有沒有偵測到」，LoQ 則進一步問「這個數字可不可信、準不準」。因此 LoQ 的門檻通常高於 LoD。
blocks.en: Limit of Quantification (LoQ): The lowest number of microorganisms that can be counted with "acceptable accuracy and precision" under the stated experimental conditions. This differs from the LoD (Limit of Detection) in the previous section: LoD asks only "was it detected or not", whereas LoQ goes further and asks "can this number be trusted, and is it accurate". The LoQ threshold is therefore usually higher than the LoD.

blocks.zh: LoQ 的推導邏輯：TR 33 並未要求另立一套全新試驗，而是直接「借用」accuracy（準確度）或 linearity（線性）研究已產生的數據——在已測試的多個稀釋濃度中，找出「最低且仍符合 accuracy/linearity 允收準則」的那個濃度，即為 LoQ。這是一種資源效率導向（reuse existing data）的設計哲學，貫穿本章多個驗證參數。
blocks.en: The derivation logic of the LoQ: TR 33 does not require a completely new study; it "borrows" the data already generated by the accuracy or linearity study. Among the dilution levels tested, find the "lowest level that still meets the accuracy/linearity acceptance criteria", and that is the LoQ. This is a resource-efficient design philosophy (reuse existing data) that runs through several validation parameters in this chapter.

blocks.zh: Poisson 分佈與統計推導：微生物在稀釋懸浮液中的分佈近似 Poisson distribution（卜瓦松分佈）——這是描述「單位時間或單位體積內離散事件發生次數」的機率分佈，特別適合極低濃度（個位數 CFU）情境。統計方法是計算每個濃度點的 99% 下限信賴界限（99% lower confidence limit）：只要這個下限在所有「更高濃度」都顯著大於零，該濃度即可視為方法能可靠量化的最低點。
blocks.en: The Poisson distribution and statistical derivation: Microorganisms in a diluted suspension are approximately distributed according to the Poisson distribution, the probability distribution describing "the number of discrete events occurring per unit time or unit volume", which is particularly suitable for very low concentrations (single-digit CFU). The statistical method is to calculate the 99% lower confidence limit at each concentration point: as long as this lower limit is significantly greater than zero at all "higher concentrations", that concentration can be regarded as the lowest point at which the method can quantify reliably.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: LoQ 就像家用體重計的「可信讀數下限」：把一枚硬幣放上體重計，指針可能會抖動、顯示 0 或亂跳的數字（這是 LoD 層次——偵測到「有東西」，但讀數不可靠）；但當放上一顆蘋果（假設 150 克），體重計能穩定、準確地顯示 150 克 ± 可接受誤差，這才是 LoQ——不只「偵測到」，而是「這個數字你可以拿去做決策」。同理，AMM/RMM 在極低濃度下可能感應到訊號，但唯有在 LoQ 以上的濃度，其計數結果才具備法規決策等級的準確度與精密度。
blocks.en: The LoQ is like the "lower limit of reliable readings" of a bathroom scale: put a coin on the scale and the needle may tremble, show 0 or jump to random numbers (this is the LoD level: detecting that "something is there" but the reading is unreliable). But when you put on an apple (say 150 g), the scale can show 150 g ± an acceptable error steadily and accurately. That is the LoQ: not only "detected", but "a number you can use for decisions". In the same way, an AMM/RMM may sense a signal at very low concentrations, but only at concentrations above the LoQ do its counts have accuracy and precision at the level needed for regulatory decisions.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調一個常被忽略的細節：低於挑戰濃度的回收計數，應以「小於稀釋濃度」（例如 "<10"）表示，而不能直接拿來計算真正的 LoQ。這是資料誠信（data integrity）與統計正確性的重要提醒——把一個「未偵測到真值」的截尾數據（censored data）當作實際觀測值代入迴歸分析，會嚴重扭曲 LoQ 的估計結果。QA 審閱驗證報告時，應特別檢查原始數據是否有此類截尾值被誤用。
blocks.en: The source stresses a detail that is often overlooked: recovered counts below the challenge level should be reported as "less than the dilution level" (for example "<10") and cannot be used directly to calculate the true LoQ. This is an important reminder about data integrity and statistical correctness: substituting censored data, where "the true value was not detected", into a regression analysis as if it were an actual observation seriously distorts the LoQ estimate. When QA reviews a validation report, it should check specifically whether the raw data contain censored values that have been misused in this way.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
LoQ 判定邏輯（Poisson / 線性迴歸法）：

1. 針對每一個稀釋濃度層級，建立濃度-反應迴歸模型
   （Poisson regression 或 linear regression）

2. 對每一濃度層級，計算 99% 下限信賴界限（99% LCL）

3. 由低濃度往高濃度檢視：
   找出最低的濃度層級，使其 99% LCL 在該層級「以上所有
   更高濃度」皆顯著大於零 → 此為統計上的最低可定量濃度

4. 最終 LoQ =
   若該濃度亦符合 accuracy（必要時含 repeatability）允收準則
     → LoQ = 該濃度
   若不符合
     → LoQ = 「已證實符合 accuracy 允收準則」的最低濃度

範例：稀釋序列預期含量 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 CFU，
若 5 CFU 濃度的 99% LCL 未能大於零，但 10 CFU 濃度可以，
且 10 CFU 濃度亦通過 accuracy 允收準則
→ 該方法的 LoQ = 10 CFU
blocks.en:
LoQ determination logic (Poisson / linear regression method):

1. For each dilution level, build a concentration-response regression model
   (Poisson regression or linear regression)

2. For each concentration level, calculate the 99% lower confidence limit (99% LCL)

3. Review from low to high concentration:
   find the lowest concentration level whose 99% LCL is significantly greater than zero
   at that level "and at all higher concentrations" → this is the statistically lowest quantifiable concentration

4. Final LoQ =
   if that concentration also meets the accuracy (and, where necessary, repeatability) acceptance criteria
     → LoQ = that concentration
   if it does not
     → LoQ = the lowest concentration "demonstrated to meet the accuracy acceptance criteria"

Example: dilution series with expected levels of 5, 10, 20, 50, 100 CFU,
if the 99% LCL at 5 CFU is not greater than zero but that at 10 CFU is,
and the 10 CFU level also passes the accuracy acceptance criteria
→ the LoQ of the method = 10 CFU

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 在 5 CFU 稀釋層級量測到的計數為 "<5"（低於預期挑戰濃度），這筆數據能否直接代入 LoQ 的迴歸分析？為什麼？
blocks.en: If an AMM/RMM measures a count of "<5" (below the expected challenge level) at the 5 CFU dilution level, can this data point be substituted directly into the LoQ regression analysis? Why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 LoQ 的統計判定要同時參照 accuracy 的允收準則，而不能僅憑迴歸分析本身的信賴界限來決定？
blocks.en: Why must the statistical determination of the LoQ also refer to the accuracy acceptance criteria, rather than relying only on the confidence limits of the regression analysis itself?

blocks.zh: 如果客戶對某 AMM/RMM 要求「LoQ 必須低於 10 CFU」作為技術規格，這會如何改變驗證試驗設計中稀釋序列的安排？
blocks.en: If a client requires "the LoQ must be below 10 CFU" as a technical specification for an AMM/RMM, how would this change the arrangement of the dilution series in the validation study design?

blocks.zh: 5.4.6 Linearity 線性
blocks.en: 5.4.6 Linearity

blocks.zh: Linearity（線性）：方法產生的結果，在特定範圍內，是否與樣品中微生物濃度（或相關分析物、量測訊號）成比例。與 accuracy 的關係是「互補」的——若 accuracy 是逐點驗證，linearity 則能證明「兩個已驗證點之間」的任何濃度也同樣準確，等於用較少的試驗點涵蓋整個範圍。
blocks.en: Linearity: Whether the results produced by the method are proportional, within a given range, to the concentration of microorganisms (or the relevant analyte or measured signal) in the sample. Its relationship with accuracy is "complementary": if accuracy is verified point by point, linearity can show that any concentration "between two verified points" is equally accurate, which amounts to covering the whole range with fewer test points.

blocks.zh: 兩種線性視角：① 絕對讀數線性（5.4.6.2）——AMM/RMM 的計數對微生物數量作圖，理想情況是「通過原點、斜率非零」的直線，此時稱為 proportionality（比例性），斜率即代表方法在該濃度範圍的回收率（recovery）。② 相對讀數線性（5.4.6.3）——把每次計數換算成相對於初始 spike 濃度的比例，理想情況是一條「斜率為零的水平線」，因為所有濃度下的平均相對回收率應該一致。兩者殊途同歸：只要方法確實線性，兩種畫法都會得到相同結論。
blocks.en: Two views of linearity: (1) Linearity of absolute readings (5.4.6.2): plot the AMM/RMM count against the number of microorganisms. The ideal is a straight line "through the origin with a non-zero slope", which is called proportionality, and the slope represents the recovery of the method over that concentration range. (2) Linearity of relative readings (5.4.6.3): convert each count into a proportion relative to the initial spike level. The ideal is a "horizontal line with zero slope", because the mean relative recovery should be the same at all concentrations. The two reach the same conclusion: if the method is truly linear, both ways of plotting give the same answer.

blocks.zh: 迴歸分析四項檢定：① 斜率 p 值（判斷斜率是否顯著非零——絕對計數要非零、相對計數則要接近零）② 截距 p 值（絕對計數理想是截距不顯著異於零以支持比例性；相對計數則截距代表平均回收率，理應顯著不為零）③ 適合度檢定（goodness-of-fit，不應顯著，否則代表模型與資料不吻合）④ R2（決定係數）——僅是線性的「間接」指標，R2 高不保證線性成立，因為 R2 也受測試濃度範圍影響（範圍越窄，R2 越容易偏高）。
blocks.en: Four tests in the regression analysis: (1) p value of the slope (to judge whether the slope is significantly non-zero: for absolute counts it should be non-zero, for relative counts it should be close to zero); (2) p value of the intercept (for absolute counts the ideal is an intercept not significantly different from zero, supporting proportionality; for relative counts the intercept represents the mean recovery and should be significantly different from zero); (3) goodness-of-fit test (should not be significant, otherwise the model does not match the data); (4) R2 (coefficient of determination): only an "indirect" indicator of linearity. A high R2 does not guarantee linearity, because R2 is also affected by the range of concentrations tested (the narrower the range, the more easily R2 comes out high).

blocks.zh: Linearity 就像體溫計的刻度設計：好的體溫計必須「每上升 1°C，指針或數字顯示就穩定地多跳動固定的格數」，不會在 37°C 附近很準、但在 40°C 附近突然壓縮或膨脹刻度。若你把每次量測結果除以「真實體溫」畫成一條線（相對讀數法），理想上應該是一條水平線——不管量 36°C 還是 40°C，量測值與真實值的比例應該維持一致。反之，若某體溫計在低溫時準、但發燒的高溫區間開始失真，就代表這支溫度計的 linearity 只在部分範圍內成立，臨床上使用時必須註明其有效量測區間（也就是下一節的 Range）。
blocks.en: Linearity is like the scale design of a thermometer: a good thermometer must "show a fixed number of divisions more for every 1°C rise, steadily", without being very accurate near 37°C but suddenly compressing or stretching the scale near 40°C. If you divide each measured result by the "true body temperature" and plot a line (the relative reading method), the ideal is a horizontal line: whether you measure 36°C or 40°C, the ratio of measured to true value should stay consistent. Conversely, if a thermometer is accurate at low temperatures but starts to distort in the high fever range, its linearity holds only over part of the range, and in clinical use its valid measuring interval must be stated (which is the Range in the next section).

blocks.zh: 原文提醒：R2 只是線性的間接證據，不是充分證據——即使 R2 高達 0.99，也可能是因為測試的濃度範圍太窄（例如只測了彼此接近的三個濃度），掩蓋了真實的非線性關係。因此驗證方案設計時，應優先確保測試濃度「涵蓋方法宣稱的完整範圍」，並搭配適合度檢定（goodness-of-fit test）而非只看 R2，才能真正證明線性成立。這也解釋了為什麼原文要求「至少 3 個濃度、建議更多」——濃度點越多、越分散，線性判定才越可靠。
blocks.en: The source warns that R2 is only indirect evidence of linearity, not sufficient evidence. Even an R2 as high as 0.99 may be due to a concentration range that is too narrow (for example only three concentrations close to each other), which masks a true non-linear relationship. When designing the validation protocol, you should therefore first make sure the concentrations tested "cover the full range the method claims", and combine this with a goodness-of-fit test rather than looking only at R2, in order to truly demonstrate linearity. This also explains why the source requires "at least 3 concentrations, more recommended": the more concentration points and the wider their spread, the more reliable the linearity judgment.

blocks.zh:
絕對讀數迴歸模型（Proportionality）：
  Count(AMM/RMM) = a + b × (微生物數量)
  理想情況：a ≈ 0（截距不顯著異於零）， b ≠ 0 且顯著
  → b 即代表方法在此範圍內的平均回收率（recovery）

相對讀數迴歸模型：
  Relative Count = Count(AMM/RMM) / 已知/預期濃度
  Relative Count = a + b × (微生物數量)
  理想情況：b ≈ 0（斜率不顯著異於零，水平線）
            a 顯著不為零 → a 即為平均回收率估計值

允收準則（5.4.6.5）：
  1. 斜率、截距符合上述方向與顯著性要求
  2. 適合度檢定（goodness-of-fit）不顯著
  3. 絕對讀數迴歸：R2 ≥ 90%（建議門檻）
blocks.en:
Absolute reading regression model (proportionality):
  Count(AMM/RMM) = a + b × (number of microorganisms)
  Ideal: a ≈ 0 (intercept not significantly different from zero), b ≠ 0 and significant
  → b represents the mean recovery of the method over this range

Relative reading regression model:
  Relative Count = Count(AMM/RMM) / known/expected concentration
  Relative Count = a + b × (number of microorganisms)
  Ideal: b ≈ 0 (slope not significantly different from zero, a horizontal line)
            a significantly different from zero → a is the estimate of the mean recovery

Acceptance criteria (5.4.6.5):
  1. The slope and intercept meet the directions and significance requirements above
  2. The goodness-of-fit test is not significant
  3. Absolute reading regression: R2 ≥ 90% (recommended threshold)

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 的絕對計數迴歸分析得到 R2 = 0.95，但適合度檢定（goodness-of-fit test）顯著（p < 0.05），這代表什麼？該方法的線性可以宣稱成立嗎？
blocks.en: If the absolute count regression analysis of an AMM/RMM gives R2 = 0.95 but the goodness-of-fit test is significant (p < 0.05), what does this mean? Can the linearity of the method be claimed to hold?

blocks.zh: 為什麼「相對讀數」線性分析理想上要求斜率趨近於零，而「絕對讀數」分析卻要求斜率顯著不為零？兩者矛盾嗎？
blocks.en: Why does the "relative reading" linearity analysis ideally require a slope close to zero while the "absolute reading" analysis requires a slope significantly different from zero? Is this a contradiction?

blocks.zh: 若某方法只在 10-50 CFU 範圍內做了 3 個濃度測試，但供應商宣稱方法適用範圍為 1-1000 CFU，這樣的線性研究設計是否足夠支持宣稱範圍？
blocks.en: If a method was tested at only 3 concentrations in the range 10-50 CFU, but the supplier claims the method applies over 1-1000 CFU, is such a linearity study design sufficient to support the claimed range?

blocks.zh: 5.4.7 Range 範圍
blocks.en: 5.4.7 Range

blocks.zh: Range（範圍）：已證實方法具備 accuracy（準確度）、precision（精密度）與 linearity（線性）的微生物數量（或相關分析物、量測訊號）上下限區間。這是本章最「精簡」的一個驗證參數——它沒有獨立的試驗程序、沒有專屬的統計分析、也沒有另立的允收準則，而是完全「繼承」前面三個參數（accuracy、repeatability、linearity）已經產生的數據。
blocks.en: Range: The interval between the upper and lower numbers of microorganisms (or the relevant analyte or measured signal) over which the method has been shown to have accuracy, precision and linearity. This is the most "concise" validation parameter in this chapter: it has no independent test procedure, no dedicated statistical analysis and no separate acceptance criteria, but wholly "inherits" the data already generated for the previous three parameters (accuracy, repeatability, linearity).

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Range 不需要新試驗？邏輯上，Range 的本質是一個「宣告」而非「試驗」——只要 accuracy、repeatability、linearity 三者都已經在某個濃度區間內被證實成立，這個區間就自動成為方法的 Range。因此 Range 章節在驗證報告中的角色，是彙整並清楚陳述「這個方法在哪個濃度區間內是可信的」，而不是設計新的挑戰試驗。
blocks.en: Why does Range not need a new study? Logically, Range is essentially a "declaration" rather than a "study": as long as accuracy, repeatability and linearity have all been demonstrated within a concentration interval, that interval automatically becomes the Range of the method. The role of the Range section in the validation report is therefore to compile and state clearly "the concentration interval within which this method is reliable", rather than to design a new challenge study.

blocks.zh: Range 就像汽車儀表板上的「時速計可靠區間」：車廠不會為了「證明時速計在 200 km/h 時準確」而另外設計一套全新試驗，而是直接引用煞車測試、風阻測試、輪胎耐久測試中，各個速度區間下時速計讀數與實際 GPS 測速的比對數據。只要 20-180 km/h 之間的準確度、重複性、線性都已在其他測試中被證實，車廠就可以宣稱「時速計在 20-180 km/h 範圍內可靠」——這正是 Range 章節「彙整既有證據、宣告可信區間」而非「另做新試驗」的精神。
blocks.en: Range is like the "reliable interval of the speedometer" on a car dashboard: the manufacturer does not design a completely new test to "prove that the speedometer is accurate at 200 km/h", but directly cites the comparison data of speedometer readings against actual GPS speed at each speed interval from the braking tests, wind resistance tests and tire durability tests. As long as accuracy, repeatability and linearity between 20 and 180 km/h have been demonstrated in other tests, the manufacturer can claim that "the speedometer is reliable between 20 and 180 km/h". This is exactly the spirit of the Range section: "compile existing evidence and declare the reliable interval" rather than "run a new study".

blocks.zh: 雖然 Range 本身不需要統計分析，但驗證報告中仍必須明確陳述該範圍是由哪些 accuracy、repeatability、linearity 數據支持，並確保「實際測試過的濃度」與「方法宣稱的適用範圍」一致。常見稽核缺失是：報告中宣稱的 Range 超出實際測試涵蓋的濃度區間——例如只測試了 10-100 CFU，卻在方法書中宣稱適用於 1-1000 CFU，這會被稽核員視為證據不足。
blocks.en: Although Range itself needs no statistical analysis, the validation report must still state explicitly which accuracy, repeatability and linearity data support the range, and ensure that "the concentrations actually tested" are consistent with "the applicable range claimed for the method". A common audit deficiency is a Range claimed in the report that goes beyond the concentration interval actually tested, for example testing only 10-100 CFU but claiming in the method document that it applies to 1-1000 CFU, which auditors will regard as insufficient evidence.

blocks.zh: 如果某方法的 accuracy 研究測試了 10-500 CFU，但 linearity 研究只測試了 50-500 CFU，這個方法最終可宣稱的 Range 應該是多少？
blocks.en: If the accuracy study of a method tested 10-500 CFU but the linearity study tested only 50-500 CFU, what Range can the method finally claim?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Range 不需要獨立的允收準則，而是直接引用 accuracy、repeatability、linearity 的允收結果？這種設計對驗證文件的可追溯性（traceability）有什麼要求？
blocks.en: Why does Range not need independent acceptance criteria but directly cites the acceptance results of accuracy, repeatability and linearity? What does this design require of the traceability of the validation documents?

blocks.zh: 5.4.8 Ruggedness 堅牢性
blocks.en: 5.4.8 Ruggedness

blocks.zh: Ruggedness（堅牢性）：在「各種正常測試條件」下（不同分析員、不同儀器、不同試劑批號、不同日期）重複測試同一樣品所得結果的 intermediate precision 或 reproducibility 程度。可視為方法對「操作面與環境面變異」的內在抵抗力。
blocks.en: Ruggedness: The degree of intermediate precision or reproducibility of results obtained when the same sample is tested repeatedly under "various normal test conditions" (different analysts, different instruments, different reagent lots, different days). It can be seen as the inherent resistance of the method to "variation in operations and environment".

blocks.zh: Intermediate Precision vs. Reproducibility：原文明確區分——同一實驗室內做的變異性測試稱為 intermediate precision（含不同分析員、不同儀器、不同日期）；跨實驗室做的則稱為 reproducibility。Ruggedness 是這兩者的統稱概念，實際執行時要看試驗是在單一或多個實驗室進行。
blocks.en: Intermediate precision vs. reproducibility: The source clearly distinguishes the two: variability testing done within the same laboratory (including different analysts, different instruments, different days) is called intermediate precision, while that done across laboratories is called reproducibility. Ruggedness is the umbrella concept for both, and in practice it depends on whether the study is run in a single laboratory or in several.

blocks.zh: 供應商與使用端的責任分工：Ruggedness 通常由供應商執行，使用端（end user）可接受供應商數據支持驗證與法規送審，但使用端仍須對供應商數據做風險評估，確認是否涵蓋自身實際使用情境（例如使用端修改了儀器或工作流程，供應商的原始 ruggedness 數據可能已不再適用，須重做）。
blocks.en: Division of responsibility between supplier and user: Ruggedness is usually performed by the supplier, and the end user may accept the supplier's data in support of validation and regulatory submission. However, the end user must still perform a risk assessment of the supplier's data to confirm whether it covers its own actual conditions of use (for example, if the end user has modified the instrument or workflow, the supplier's original ruggedness data may no longer apply and must be repeated).

blocks.zh: Ruggedness 就像米其林餐廳評鑑同一道招牌菜的穩定度：不管是週一還是週五（不同天）、由主廚或副主廚掌鍋（不同分析員）、用新到貨的還是庫存的食材批號（不同試劑批號）、用 A 廚房還是 B 廚房的爐具（不同儀器），這道菜的鹹淡與品質都應該維持在可接受的一致水準內。若某天菜的鹹度忽然大幅波動，代表這道菜的「配方」對日常操作變異的抵抗力不足——這正是 ruggedness 想要量化的：方法本身對這些「正常會發生的操作變異」有多穩健。
blocks.en: Ruggedness is like the Michelin guide assessing the consistency of a restaurant's signature dish: whether it is Monday or Friday (different days), whether the head chef or the sous chef is at the stove (different analysts), whether newly delivered or stored ingredient lots are used (different reagent lots), and whether the stove in kitchen A or B is used (different instruments), the saltiness and quality of the dish should stay within an acceptable range of consistency. If the saltiness suddenly fluctuates widely one day, the "recipe" of the dish is not resistant enough to everyday operating variation. This is exactly what ruggedness sets out to quantify: how robust the method itself is against these "variations in operation that normally occur".

blocks.zh: 原文設下明確的試驗設計下限：run 數不得少於 6、每個 run 至少 3 重複——這是統計上估計「run 間變異」與「run 內變異」兩個變異成分所需的最低樣本規模，QA 審閱驗證方案時應優先檢查此下限是否被滿足。此外，若 accuracy 等其他驗證試驗「本身已涵蓋」不同分析員、儀器、日期等條件，則可直接從該數據反推 ruggedness，不必重複進行獨立試驗——這再次呼應本章「數據重複利用、避免過度測試」的設計思維。
blocks.en: The source sets a clear lower limit on the study design: no fewer than 6 runs, with at least 3 replicates per run. This is the minimum sample size needed statistically to estimate the two variance components, "between-run variation" and "within-run variation", and QA should check first whether this lower limit has been met when reviewing the validation protocol. In addition, if other validation studies such as accuracy "already cover" conditions such as different analysts, instruments and days, ruggedness can be derived directly from those data, without repeating a separate study. This again echoes the design thinking of this chapter: "reuse data and avoid over-testing".

blocks.zh:
Ruggedness／Intermediate Precision 之 RSD 計算（5 CFU 以上，隨機效應 ANOVA）：

  步驟 1：Var(within-run) + Var(between-run) = 總變異
  步驟 2：SD = √(總變異)
  步驟 3：SD ÷ 平均計數（mean count）
  步驟 4：× 100%  → 得到 RSD (%)

  步驟 5（95% 信賴區間）：
     以 Satterthwaite 法計算「總變異」的 95% CI
     → 取平方根 → 除以平均計數 → × 100%

  步驟 6（與 CMM 比較，選用）：
     以 ruggedness 估計值及其標準誤，計算
     比值 (CMM ÷ AMM/RMM) 的 95% 下限信賴界限
     （可於對數尺度下評估）

數值範例：
  假設 within-run variance = 4, between-run variance = 5
  總變異 = 9 → SD = 3
  平均計數 = 30 CFU
  RSD = 3 ÷ 30 × 100% = 10%
  → 對照 Table 5.4.8.3-1，101-400 CFU 範圍容許 RSD ≤ 10%
     若平均計數落在此區間，10% 即為臨界值，需檢視信賴區間

比較兩定量方法之 Comparability Margin：
  CMM/AMM 比值容許邊界 = 0.5
  自然對數尺度容許邊界 = 0.693（≈ ln(2)）
  定性方法偵測機率之 Comparability Margin = 0.7
blocks.en:
RSD calculation for ruggedness/intermediate precision (above 5 CFU, random-effects ANOVA):

  Step 1: Var(within-run) + Var(between-run) = total variance
  Step 2: SD = √(total variance)
  Step 3: SD ÷ mean count
  Step 4: × 100%  → gives RSD (%)

  Step 5 (95% confidence interval):
     calculate the 95% CI of the "total variance" by the Satterthwaite method
     → take the square root → divide by the mean count → × 100%

  Step 6 (comparison with the CMM, optional):
     using the ruggedness estimate and its standard error, calculate
     the 95% lower confidence limit of the ratio (CMM ÷ AMM/RMM)
     (can be evaluated on a logarithmic scale)

Numerical example:
  Suppose within-run variance = 4, between-run variance = 5
  total variance = 9 → SD = 3
  mean count = 30 CFU
  RSD = 3 ÷ 30 × 100% = 10%
  → Per Table 5.4.8.3-1, the 101-400 CFU range allows RSD ≤ 10%
     if the mean count falls in this interval, 10% is the borderline value and the confidence interval must be examined

Comparability margins for comparing two quantitative methods:
  Permitted boundary of the CMM/AMM ratio = 0.5
  Permitted boundary on the natural logarithm scale = 0.693 (≈ ln(2))
  Comparability margin for the detection probability of qualitative methods = 0.7

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 某 CDMO 在導入一套快速微生物偵測系統（AMM）用於原液無菌試驗前的生物負荷（bioburden）監測。供應商提供的 ruggedness 數據僅涵蓋「原廠標準操作流程」下的 6 個 run。但該 CDMO 實際導入後，因廠內 SOP 要求額外的樣品前處理步驟（供應商原始流程沒有），且改用不同廠牌的離心機。依照本節「使用端風險評估」原則，該 CDMO 必須另外執行 ruggedness 確效，涵蓋這些「使用端特有」的操作變異來源，才能主張供應商數據可支持其驗證程序——這也是 QA 在審閱供應商確效包（validation package）時最常見的落差項目。
blocks.en: A CDMO introduces a rapid microbial detection system (AMM) for bioburden monitoring before the sterility test of bulk solution. The supplier's ruggedness data cover only 6 runs under the "manufacturer's standard operating procedure". But after actual implementation, the CDMO's in-house SOP requires an additional sample preparation step (not in the supplier's original procedure) and uses a centrifuge of a different brand. Under the principle of "end-user risk assessment" in this section, the CDMO must perform a separate ruggedness qualification covering these "end-user-specific" sources of operating variation before it can claim that the supplier's data support its validation program. This is also the gap QA most often finds when reviewing a supplier's validation package.

blocks.zh: 若某方法的平均計數為 60 CFU，計算得到的 RSD 為 18%，依 Table 5.4.8.3-1，這是否符合允收準則？
blocks.en: If a method has a mean count of 60 CFU and the calculated RSD is 18%, does this meet the acceptance criterion according to Table 5.4.8.3-1?

blocks.zh: 為什麼計數低於 5 CFU 時不建議使用一般 ANOVA，而應考慮 generalized linear mixed model？這與 Poisson 分佈在低計數區的特性有何關聯？
blocks.en: Why is the ordinary ANOVA not recommended for counts below 5 CFU, with a generalized linear mixed model to be considered instead? How is this related to the characteristics of the Poisson distribution in the low count range?

blocks.zh: 使用端接手供應商的 ruggedness 數據時，應該檢查哪些「操作條件差異」以判斷是否需要補做試驗？
blocks.en: When the end user takes over the supplier's ruggedness data, which "differences in operating conditions" should be checked to decide whether supplementary studies are needed?

blocks.zh: 圖表解讀 Figure Analysis — Table 5.4.8.3-1
blocks.en: Figure Analysis: Table 5.4.8.3-1

blocks.zh: 此表格呈現一個重要規律：平均計數（CFU）越低，容許的 RSD 百分比越高（例如 5-9 CFU 容許高達 45%，101-400 CFU 則收緊至 10%）。這是因為微生物計數在低濃度區間本質上服從 Poisson 分佈，其變異係數（CV）隨計數值降低而自然升高——換言之，同樣是「±2 CFU」的絕對誤差，在平均 5 CFU 時是 40% 的相對誤差，但在平均 200 CFU 時只是 1% 的相對誤差。因此允收準則必須「隨計數區間分級」，而不能用單一固定的 RSD 門檻套用到所有濃度範圍，否則低濃度區間會被不合理地判定為不合格。實務上，QA 在審閱 ruggedness 報告時，應先確認「平均計數落在哪個區間」，再對照該區間專屬的 RSD 門檻，而非直接套用最嚴格（10%）的標準。
blocks.en: This table shows an important pattern: the lower the mean count (CFU), the higher the permitted RSD percentage (for example, 5-9 CFU allows as much as 45%, while 101-400 CFU tightens to 10%). This is because microbial counts at low concentrations essentially follow the Poisson distribution, and the coefficient of variation (CV) naturally rises as the count falls. In other words, the same absolute error of "±2 CFU" is a 40% relative error at a mean of 5 CFU but only a 1% relative error at a mean of 200 CFU. The acceptance criteria must therefore be "graded by count interval", and a single fixed RSD threshold cannot be applied to all concentration ranges, otherwise the low concentration intervals would be unreasonably judged as failing. In practice, when QA reviews a ruggedness report, it should first confirm "which interval the mean count falls in" and then compare with the RSD threshold specific to that interval, rather than directly applying the strictest (10%) criterion.

blocks.zh: 5.4.9 Robustness 耐用性
blocks.en: 5.4.9 Robustness

blocks.zh: Robustness（耐用性）：方法在其操作參數發生「刻意的微幅變動」時，仍能維持結果不受影響的能力，同時反映方法在正常使用下的可靠程度。與 Ruggedness 的差異在於：Ruggedness 測的是「操作者、儀器、日期、試劑批號」等不可完全控制的日常變異；Robustness 測的則是「試劑濃度、環境條件、儀器操作極限」等可被刻意調整的方法/系統參數的耐受度。
blocks.en: Robustness: The ability of the method to remain unaffected when its operating parameters undergo "deliberate small variations", which also reflects the reliability of the method in normal use. The difference from Ruggedness is that Ruggedness tests the day-to-day variation of factors that cannot be fully controlled, such as "operator, instrument, day and reagent lot", whereas Robustness tests the tolerance to method/system parameters that can be deliberately adjusted, such as "reagent concentration, environmental conditions and instrument operating limits".

blocks.zh: 關鍵參數（Critical Method and System Parameters）：原文列舉了具體範例——試劑濃度/體積、環境條件（溫度、濕度）、儀器操作極限、物理條件（震動）、萃取方法、樣品體積、培養參數。這些都是方法開發時應納入「刻意變動測試」的候選參數，用意是預先摸清方法的「容錯邊界」，而非等到常規使用時才發現問題。
blocks.en: Critical Method and System Parameters: The source gives specific examples: reagent concentration/volume, environmental conditions (temperature, humidity), instrument operating limits, physical conditions (vibration), extraction method, sample volume and incubation parameters. These are all candidate parameters to be included in "deliberate variation testing" during method development. The purpose is to map in advance the "margin for error" of the method rather than discovering problems only in routine use.

blocks.zh: Robustness 就像手機廠商的「壓力測試」：刻意在極端溫度（-10°C 或 45°C）、低電量、訊號不佳等條件下測試手機是否仍能正常運作。這與「不同使用者天天用手機」（類似 ruggedness，測的是自然發生的使用差異）不同——Robustness 是工程師「主動、刻意」調整操作邊界條件，找出手機在哪些條件組合下開始出現異常（例如電池溫度過高會降頻），進而在使用手冊上明確標示「建議操作溫度範圍」。同理，AMM/RMM 供應商透過 robustness 研究，明確定義試劑濃度、溫度、震動等參數的可接受操作窗（design space），提供給使用端作為日常操作的安全邊界依據。
blocks.en: Robustness is like a mobile phone manufacturer's "stress test": deliberately testing whether the phone still works under extreme temperatures (-10°C or 45°C), low battery and poor signal. This differs from "different users using the phone every day" (similar to ruggedness, which tests naturally occurring differences in use). With Robustness, engineers "actively and deliberately" adjust the boundary conditions of operation to find under which combinations of conditions the phone begins to behave abnormally (for example, throttling when the battery temperature is too high), and then state the "recommended operating temperature range" clearly in the user manual. In the same way, through robustness studies the AMM/RMM supplier clearly defines acceptable operating windows (design space) for parameters such as reagent concentration, temperature and vibration, and gives the end user a basis for safe boundaries in daily operation.

blocks.zh: 原文允許 robustness 以「簡化試驗」進行，而非每次都跑完整的 accuracy/precision 全套實驗——例如只需證明「在某關鍵參數變動後，回收計數仍落在 70% 以內、或與原設定無統計差異」即可。但若簡化試驗顯示參數變動確實造成顯著影響，則必須針對該參數的最終設定值，執行完整的 accuracy 研究。這是一個「先篩檢、後確認」的分層試驗策略，能有效節省驗證資源，但也要求使用端在審閱報告時，確認每個關鍵參數是否都有明確的「篩檢通過」或「已完整驗證」的證據軌跡。
blocks.en: The source allows robustness to be performed as a "simplified study" instead of running the full set of accuracy/precision experiments every time. For example, it suffices to show that "after a critical parameter is varied, recovered counts remain within 70% (of the original setting) or show no statistical difference from the original setting". However, if the simplified study shows that the parameter variation does cause a significant effect, then a full accuracy study must be performed for the final setting of that parameter. This is a tiered "screen first, confirm afterwards" study strategy that effectively saves validation resources, but it also requires the end user, when reviewing the report, to confirm that every critical parameter has a clear evidence trail of either "screening passed" or "fully validated".

blocks.zh: Robustness 與 Ruggedness 都涉及「變異對結果的影響」，兩者最核心的差異是什麼？請各舉一個屬於 robustness、一個屬於 ruggedness 的參數變動範例。
blocks.en: Both Robustness and Ruggedness involve "the effect of variation on results". What is the core difference between them? Give one example of a parameter variation that belongs to robustness and one that belongs to ruggedness.

blocks.zh: 若某核酸增幅技術（NAT）在 robustness 研究中，某一試劑批次的 Ct 值（threshold cycle）超出可接受範圍，這代表什麼？下一步該怎麼做？
blocks.en: If, in a robustness study of a nucleic acid amplification technique (NAT), the Ct value (threshold cycle) for one reagent lot falls outside the acceptable range, what does this mean? What should the next step be?

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文特別提醒「使用端如果修改了儀器或工作流程，可能使供應商的 robustness 數據失效」？這對 CDMO 導入他廠 AMM/RMM 系統時的技術移轉（tech transfer）流程有何啟示？
blocks.en: Why does the source specifically warn that "if the end user modifies the instrument or workflow, the supplier's robustness data may become invalid"? What does this suggest for the technology transfer process when a CDMO introduces another company's AMM/RMM system?

blocks.zh: 5.4.10 Method Suitability 方法適用性
blocks.en: 5.4.10 Method Suitability

blocks.zh: Method Suitability（方法適用性）：證明產品本身（配方、基質）對方法產生的訊號「沒有增強或抑制作用」。白話來說：方法在無菌水中測試很準，不代表放進真正的藥品配方（可能含防腐劑、蛋白質、脂質、界面活性劑）後仍然準——因為配方成分本身可能干擾偵測訊號，產生偽陽性或偽陰性。
blocks.en: Method Suitability: Demonstrates that the product itself (formulation, matrix) has "no enhancing or inhibiting effect" on the signal produced by the method. In plain terms: the method being accurate in sterile water does not mean it remains accurate once placed in the real drug formulation (which may contain preservatives, proteins, lipids and surfactants), because the formulation components themselves may interfere with the detection signal and produce false positives or false negatives.

blocks.zh: Inclusivity vs. Exclusivity：Inclusivity（納入性）測試方法是否能偵測到「目標微生物」；Exclusivity（排除性）測試方法是否能正確排除「非目標或近緣微生物」而不誤判為陽性。兩者合稱特異性驗證的操作性延伸，在方法適用性研究中，需分別用目標菌與近緣菌加以驗證。
blocks.en: Inclusivity vs. exclusivity: Inclusivity tests whether the method can detect the "target microorganisms"; exclusivity tests whether the method correctly excludes "non-target or closely related microorganisms" without misjudging them as positive. Together they form the operational extension of the specificity validation, and in the method suitability study they must be verified separately with target organisms and closely related organisms.

blocks.zh: 偽陽性 vs. 偽陰性試驗設計：①偽陽性試驗——不含任何挑戰菌的樣品基質，直接進行常規流程，觀察是否「無中生有」出現陽性訊號（同時應設無樣品基質的陰性對照）。②偽陰性試驗——在樣品基質中接種 <100 CFU 的相關菌株，觀察方法是否能正確偵測到，同時設無樣品基質的陽性對照組作比對基準。
blocks.en: False-positive vs. false-negative study design: (1) False-positive study: run the sample matrix, containing no challenge organisms, through the routine workflow and observe whether a positive signal appears "out of nothing" (a negative control without sample matrix should also be set up). (2) False-negative study: inoculate the sample matrix with <100 CFU of relevant strains and observe whether the method detects them correctly, with a positive control group without sample matrix as the comparison baseline.

blocks.zh: Method Suitability 就像機場行李金屬探測儀在偵測不同材質行李箱時的表現：探測儀本身經過校正沒問題，但如果某款行李箱內襯含有金屬纖維（干擾物質），可能導致「行李箱本身」觸發警報，即使裡面根本沒有違禁品——這就是偽陽性。反過來，如果某款軟殼行李箱的材質會吸收訊號、遮蔽内部真正藏有的金屬物品，導致探測儀沒有反應，這就是偽陰性。因此機場安檢不能只驗證探測儀「對空氣」的靈敏度，還必須針對不同材質行李箱（product matrix）逐一驗證「探測儀＋行李箱組合」是否仍然可靠——這正是 method suitability 的精神：驗證的對象不只是方法本身，而是「方法＋產品基質」的組合表現。
blocks.en: Method Suitability is like how an airport baggage metal detector performs on suitcases of different materials: the detector itself is calibrated and fine, but if the lining of a certain suitcase contains metal fibers (an interfering substance), the "suitcase itself" may trigger the alarm even though there is no prohibited item inside. That is a false positive. Conversely, if the material of a soft-shell suitcase absorbs the signal and shields metal items actually hidden inside so that the detector does not respond, that is a false negative. Airport security therefore cannot verify only the sensitivity of the detector "against air"; it must verify one by one, for suitcases of different materials (the product matrix), whether the "detector plus suitcase combination" remains reliable. This is the spirit of method suitability: what is verified is not only the method itself but the performance of the "method plus product matrix" combination.

blocks.zh: 原文特別點名一個容易被忽略的干擾來源：最終包材（final packaging）——例如某些非生長型 AMM/RMM（如生物螢光粒子計數）可能因包材材質改變而影響背景粒子偵測數量，因此在做「產品分組」（product grouping，以相似配方減少重複試驗）之前，必須先確認包材本身是否會造成干擾。此外，死菌（dead cells）或消毒劑殘留也可能誘發偽陽性訊號——這對於採用生物螢光原理的 AMM/RMM 尤其關鍵，直接關聯到環境監測（EM）取樣時機的實務安排（例如須待消毒劑揮發完畢後才能取樣）。
blocks.en: The source specifically names an easily overlooked source of interference: the final packaging. For example, some nongrowth-based AMM/RMM (such as bio-fluorescent particle counting) may have the number of background particles detected affected by a change in packaging material, so before "product grouping" (using similar formulations to reduce repeated studies), it must first be confirmed whether the packaging itself causes interference. In addition, dead cells or disinfectant residues may also induce false-positive signals. This is especially critical for AMM/RMM using the bio-fluorescence principle, and relates directly to the practical arrangement of environmental monitoring (EM) sampling timing (for example, sampling only after the disinfectant has fully evaporated).

blocks.zh:
方法適用性允收準則（定量方法，可直接與陽性對照比較時）：

  最低回收率 = 50%（即「係數 2」）

  回收率(%) = (含樣品基質之計數 ÷ 陽性對照計數) × 100%

  範例：
    陽性對照（無樣品基質）計數 = 80 CFU
    含樣品基質之計數 = 45 CFU
    回收率 = 45 ÷ 80 × 100% = 56.25% → 符合 ≥50% 允收準則

  若無法直接與 CMM 比較（如 non-CFU 訊號），
  則改採 Section 5.4.11.1 之 comparability 統計方法評估
blocks.en:
Method suitability acceptance criterion (quantitative methods, when a direct comparison with the positive control is possible):

  Minimum recovery = 50% (that is, "a factor of 2")

  Recovery (%) = (count with sample matrix ÷ positive control count) × 100%

  Example:
    Positive control (no sample matrix) count = 80 CFU
    Count with sample matrix = 45 CFU
    Recovery = 45 ÷ 80 × 100% = 56.25% → meets the ≥50% acceptance criterion

  If a direct comparison with the CMM is not possible (such as non-CFU signals),
  then evaluate using the comparability statistical methods of Section 5.4.11.1 instead

blocks.zh: 某產品的三個批次配方僅在賦形劑濃度上略有差異，是否可以引用「最具挑戰性」的那一批次數據，來代表其他批次的方法適用性？需要滿足什麼前提？
blocks.en: Three batches of a product differ only slightly in excipient concentration. Can the data from the "most challenging" batch be cited to represent the method suitability of the other batches? What preconditions must be met?

blocks.zh: 為什麼偽陰性試驗的挑戰濃度規定為 <100 CFU，但原文特別聲明「這不代表挑戰濃度必須設在 LoD 或 LoQ 層級」？兩者的試驗目的有何不同？
blocks.en: Why is the challenge level for the false-negative study specified as <100 CFU, while the source specifically states that "this does not mean the challenge level must be set at the LoD or LoQ level"? How do the purposes of the two studies differ?

blocks.zh: 若某 AMM/RMM 用於環境監測，且已知某款消毒劑會引發偽陽性，除了方法適用性試驗本身，還應該從哪些操作面（如取樣時機、SOP 設計）著手降低風險？
blocks.en: If an AMM/RMM is used for environmental monitoring and a certain disinfectant is known to trigger false positives, in addition to the method suitability study itself, from which operational aspects (such as sampling timing and SOP design) should you start in order to reduce the risk?

blocks.zh: 5.4.11 Comparability 可比性
blocks.en: 5.4.11 Comparability

blocks.zh: Comparability（可比性）：證明 AMM/RMM 對微生物的定性或定量偵測結果，與既有方法（CMM）相比，達到「相等（equivalent）、不劣（non-inferior）或無統計差異」——具體採用哪一種統計架構，取決於比較的統計方法。這是本章「驗證邏輯鏈」的最後一環：前面 accuracy、precision、LoD、LoQ、linearity、range、ruggedness、robustness、method suitability 都是針對 AMM/RMM「自身」的表現特性，而 Comparability 則是把 AMM/RMM 直接放到 CMM 旁邊做「頭對頭」比較。
blocks.en: Comparability: Demonstrates that the qualitative or quantitative detection results of the AMM/RMM for microorganisms are "equivalent, non-inferior or not statistically different" compared with the existing method (CMM). Which of these statistical frameworks is used depends on the statistical method of the comparison. This is the last link in the "validation logic chain" of this chapter: accuracy, precision, LoD, LoQ, linearity, range, ruggedness, robustness and method suitability all concern performance characteristics of the AMM/RMM "itself", whereas Comparability puts the AMM/RMM directly beside the CMM for a "head-to-head" comparison.

blocks.zh: 訊號可比性的三種情境：① AMM/RMM 產生 CFU 訊號——可直接與傳統 CFU 法比較，統計架構與主要驗證相同。② AMM/RMM 產生 non-CFU 訊號（如螢光單位、ATP 相對光單位、NAT 陽性反應）——訊號無法直接換算成 CFU，須建立「預測模型」或求出「CFU 訊號的上限」。③ AMM/RMM 為連續/多次取樣型（如 BFPC 生物螢光粒子計數器）——CMM 通常只能做單次、片段式取樣，兩者資料結構本質不同，須採取基準值（baseline）、平行測試或分布比對等替代策略。
blocks.en: Three situations of signal comparability: (1) The AMM/RMM produces a CFU signal: it can be compared directly with the traditional CFU method, and the statistical framework is the same as for primary validation. (2) The AMM/RMM produces a non-CFU signal (such as fluorescence units, ATP relative light units, NAT positive reactions): the signal cannot be converted directly into CFU, so a "prediction model" must be established or an "upper limit of the CFU signal" derived. (3) The AMM/RMM is a continuous/multiple-sampling type (such as the BFPC bio-fluorescent particle counter): the CMM can usually only perform single, discrete sampling, so the data structures of the two are fundamentally different, and alternative strategies such as baseline values, parallel testing or distribution comparison are needed.

blocks.zh: Noninferiority vs. Superiority：當 AMM/RMM 與 CMM 使用「相同微生物相關訊號」時，比較重點通常是 noninferiority（不劣性）——證明 AMM/RMM 不會明顯比 CMM 差。但當 AMM/RMM 產生 non-CFU 或非生長型訊號時，因為這類方法常能回收「受損、受壓迫或 VBNC（viable but nonculturable，存活但不可培養）」的微生物，反而可能比傳統方法「偵測到更多」，此時應改採 superiority（優越性）框架評估——這正呼應 USP <1223> 提出的 decision-equivalence（決策等效性）概念：只要兩種方法導向相同的品質決策（放行/拒收），即使絕對訊號數值不同，也可視為可比。
blocks.en: Noninferiority vs. superiority: When the AMM/RMM and the CMM use the "same microbe-related signal", the comparison usually focuses on noninferiority, demonstrating that the AMM/RMM is not clearly worse than the CMM. But when the AMM/RMM produces a non-CFU or nongrowth-based signal, such methods can often recover "injured, stressed or VBNC (viable but nonculturable)" microorganisms and may "detect more" than the traditional method, so a superiority framework should be adopted instead. This echoes the concept of decision-equivalence raised in USP <1223>: as long as the two methods lead to the same quality decision (release/reject), they can be regarded as comparable even if the absolute signal values differ.

blocks.zh: Comparability 就像用新舊兩款體重計比較準確度：如果新舊體重計都是以「公斤」為單位（相同訊號類型 = CFU vs CFU），只要新體重計量出的數字「不明顯低於」舊體重計（noninferiority），就可以放心換用新體重計。但如果新體重計改用「體脂肪感應電流」這種全新的訊號型態（non-CFU 訊號），就不能直接拿「電流值」跟「公斤數」比大小，而必須先建立一套「電流值 → 預估體重」的換算模型（prediction model），或至少證明「電流值超過某個門檻時，體重必然落在某個安全範圍內」（上限對應關係）。若新體重計號稱能偵測到「舊體重計量不到的水腫水分」（如同 AMM/RMM 偵測 VBNC 微生物），則評估重點就從「兩者一樣準」轉為「新體重計偵測得更全面」（superiority）。
blocks.en: Comparability is like comparing the accuracy of a new and an old bathroom scale. If both scales use "kilograms" (the same signal type = CFU vs. CFU), then as long as the number from the new scale is "not clearly lower" than the old (noninferiority), you can safely switch to the new one. But if the new scale uses a completely new signal type such as "body-fat sensing current" (a non-CFU signal), you cannot directly compare the "current value" with the "kilogram figure". You must first build a "current value → estimated weight" conversion model (prediction model), or at least show that "when the current exceeds a certain threshold, the weight must fall within a certain safe range" (an upper-limit relationship). If the new scale claims it can detect "edema water that the old scale cannot measure" (like an AMM/RMM detecting VBNC microorganisms), then the focus of the assessment shifts from "both equally accurate" to "the new scale detects more comprehensively" (superiority).

blocks.zh: 原文特別強調，Comparability 研究應優先於 Method Suitability 之後進行——先確認樣品基質不會造成干擾或偽陽性/偽陰性，再進行方法間的頭對頭比較，避免將「基質干擾」誤判為「方法間的訊號差異」。此外，對於連續取樣型 AMM/RMM（如環境監測用的 BFPC），原文提出了一個關鍵洞見：Grade A 環境下通常偵測不到陽性事件，因此必須改在「預期會有微生物回收」的較低分級潔淨室環境中執行比較性研究，才能取得有意義的統計數據——這對於無菌製劑 CDMO 規劃 AMM/RMM 環境監測導入試驗的場域選擇，具有直接的實務指導意義。
blocks.en: The source specifically stresses that the Comparability study should be performed after Method Suitability: first confirm that the sample matrix does not cause interference or false positives/false negatives, then carry out the head-to-head comparison between methods, to avoid mistaking "matrix interference" for a "signal difference between methods". In addition, for continuous-sampling AMM/RMM (such as the BFPC used for environmental monitoring), the source offers a key insight: positive events are usually not detected in a Grade A environment, so the comparative study must instead be run in a lower-grade cleanroom environment where "microbial recovery is expected" in order to obtain meaningful statistical data. This is of direct practical guidance for a sterile products CDMO choosing the location for the implementation study of an AMM/RMM for environmental monitoring.

blocks.zh:
Decision-Equivalence 概念（USP <1223>）：
  即使 AMM/RMM 訊號（如螢光單位、ATP 相對光單位）
  與 CMM 訊號（CFU）數值上不可直接互換，
  只要兩者導向「相同的品質決策」（放行 / 拒收 / OOE 警示），
  即可視為 Comparable。

Out-of-Expectation (OOE) 上限控制界限設定：
  Upper Control Limit = 2～3 × 可接受訊噪比 (S/N)
  （依 ICH Q2(R2) 與 USP <1225> 之建議）

比較策略選擇邏輯：
  訊號類型相同（CFU vs CFU）        → Noninferiority 檢定
  Non-CFU 訊號、預期回收率更高      → Superiority 檢定
  連續監測型（如 BFPC）、訊號不連續對應 CFU
      → 基準值(baseline)法 或 平行測試法 或
        CFU 分布比對法 或 偵測頻率比對法
blocks.en:
Decision-equivalence concept (USP <1223>):
  Even if AMM/RMM signals (such as fluorescence units or ATP relative light units)
  and CMM signals (CFU) cannot be interchanged numerically,
  as long as both lead to the "same quality decision" (release / reject / OOE alert),
  they can be regarded as comparable.

Setting the Out-of-Expectation (OOE) upper control limit:
  Upper Control Limit = 2-3 × acceptable signal-to-noise ratio (S/N)
  (per recommendations in ICH Q2(R2) and USP <1225>)

Logic for choosing the comparison strategy:
  Same signal type (CFU vs CFU)        → Noninferiority test
  Non-CFU signal, higher recovery expected      → Superiority test
  Continuous monitoring type (such as BFPC), signal not directly corresponding to CFU
      → baseline method, or parallel testing method, or
        CFU distribution comparison method, or detection frequency comparison method

blocks.zh: 某無菌針劑 CDMO 導入一套連續生物螢光粒子計數器（BFPC）取代傳統主動空氣採樣器，用於 Grade B 走廊的即時環境監測。由於 Grade A/B 環境下傳統方法本來就極少偵測到陽性事件，直接做「頭對頭平行測試」難以取得有意義的比較數據。依本節建議，該 CDMO 改在偵測率較高的 Grade C 或 Grade D 區域先建立 BFPC 的基準訊號分布，再以迴歸分析求出「BFPC 訊號」與「CMM CFU 計數」的對應關係，進而反推出 Grade B 走廊使用時，BFPC 訊號應設定在何種閾值以觸發 OOE 警示——這正是原文所述「決定 non-CFU 訊號給定下 CFU 分布範圍」的實務應用路徑。
blocks.en: A sterile injectables CDMO introduces a continuous bio-fluorescent particle counter (BFPC) to replace the traditional active air sampler for real-time environmental monitoring of a Grade B corridor. Because the traditional method rarely detects positive events in Grade A/B environments anyway, a direct "head-to-head parallel test" would hardly produce meaningful comparison data. Following the recommendation of this section, the CDMO first establishes the baseline signal distribution of the BFPC in Grade C or Grade D areas, where the detection rate is higher, then uses regression analysis to find the relationship between the "BFPC signal" and the "CMM CFU count", and from this works out the threshold at which the BFPC signal should be set to trigger an OOE alert when used in the Grade B corridor. This is exactly the practical route described in the source for "determining the range of the CFU distribution given a non-CFU signal".

blocks.zh: 為什麼原文建議 Comparability 測試應在 Method Suitability 之後進行，而不是同時或提前進行？
blocks.en: Why does the source recommend that Comparability testing be carried out after Method Suitability, rather than at the same time or earlier?

blocks.zh: 某 AMM/RMM 使用 ATP 生物冷光訊號（非 CFU），且已知其能回收部分 VBNC 微生物，此時應採用 noninferiority 還是 superiority 統計架構？為什麼？
blocks.en: An AMM/RMM uses an ATP bioluminescence signal (non-CFU) and is known to recover some VBNC microorganisms. Should a noninferiority or a superiority statistical framework be used here? Why?

blocks.zh: 若某連續監測型 AMM/RMM 部署於 Grade A 環境，長期沒有偵測到任何陽性事件，該如何設計一個有統計意義的 comparability 研究？
blocks.en: If a continuous-monitoring AMM/RMM is deployed in a Grade A environment and detects no positive event over a long period, how should a statistically meaningful comparability study be designed?

blocks.zh: Decision-equivalence（決策等效性）概念與傳統「數值上完全對應」的可比性思維有何本質差異？這對法規機關審查 AMM/RMM 導入案的角度會有什麼影響？
blocks.en: What is the essential difference between the concept of decision-equivalence and the traditional thinking of comparability as "exact numerical correspondence"? How would this affect the perspective of regulators reviewing an AMM/RMM implementation?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: LoQ 借用 accuracy/linearity 既有數據，以 Poisson 迴歸求出「99% 下限信賴界限大於零」的最低濃度作為定量極限，且低於挑戰濃度的計數須以截尾值（"<N"）表示、不得誤用於統計推導
blocks.en: LoQ borrows the existing accuracy/linearity data and uses Poisson regression to find the lowest concentration at which "the 99% lower confidence limit is greater than zero" as the limit of quantification. Counts below the challenge level must be reported as censored values ("<N") and must not be misused in statistical derivation

blocks.zh: Linearity 可從絕對計數（理想通過原點的比例性直線）或相對計數（理想水平線）兩種角度評估，須以斜率/截距顯著性、適合度檢定與 R2（絕對計數建議 ≥90%）綜合判定，R2 高不等於線性成立
blocks.en: Linearity can be evaluated from the view of absolute counts (ideally a proportionality line through the origin) or relative counts (ideally a horizontal line), and must be judged comprehensively from the significance of the slope/intercept, the goodness-of-fit test and R2 (≥90% recommended for absolute counts). A high R2 does not mean linearity holds

blocks.zh: Range 完全繼承 accuracy、repeatability、linearity 已驗證的數據區間，無需另立試驗或統計分析，僅需彙整並陳述宣稱範圍與實際測試範圍的一致性
blocks.en: Range wholly inherits the data interval already verified for accuracy, repeatability and linearity, needs no separate study or statistical analysis, and only requires compiling and stating that the claimed range is consistent with the range actually tested

blocks.zh: Ruggedness 以隨機效應 ANOVA 拆解 run 內/run 間變異，透過五步驟公式換算為 RSD(%)，並依 Table 5.4.8.3-1 隨 CFU 平均計數區間分級套用允收門檻（5-9 CFU 容許 45%，101-400 CFU 收緊至 10%）
blocks.en: Ruggedness uses random-effects ANOVA to separate within-run/between-run variation, converts it to RSD (%) through the five-step formula, and applies acceptance thresholds graded by mean CFU count interval according to Table 5.4.8.3-1 (5-9 CFU allows 45%, tightening to 10% at 101-400 CFU)

blocks.zh: Robustness 聚焦「刻意調整」的關鍵方法/系統參數（試劑濃度、環境條件、儀器操作極限等）耐受度，可用簡化篩檢試驗（如 70% 回收率門檻）取代全套驗證，但篩檢未過須補做完整 accuracy 研究
blocks.en: Robustness focuses on the tolerance to "deliberately adjusted" critical method/system parameters (reagent concentration, environmental conditions, instrument operating limits and so on). A simplified screening study (such as a 70% recovery threshold) may replace the full validation, but if screening is not passed, a full accuracy study must be added

blocks.zh: Method Suitability 驗證產品配方/基質是否干擾方法訊號，須分別設計偽陽性與偽陰性試驗，並涵蓋 inclusivity/exclusivity 與潛在干擾物質（如消毒劑、死菌）評估，允收準則要求無偽陽性、至少 50% 回收率
blocks.en: Method Suitability verifies whether the product formulation/matrix interferes with the method signal. False-positive and false-negative studies must be designed separately, covering inclusivity/exclusivity and the assessment of potential interfering substances (such as disinfectants and dead cells). The acceptance criteria require no false positives and at least 50% recovery

blocks.zh: Comparability 依訊號型態（CFU / non-CFU / 連續監測）選擇 noninferiority 或 superiority 統計框架，並可援引 USP <1223> 的 decision-equivalence 概念，處理無法直接數值對應的訊號比較情境
blocks.en: Comparability selects a noninferiority or superiority statistical framework according to the signal type (CFU / non-CFU / continuous monitoring), and may invoke the decision-equivalence concept of USP <1223> to handle signal comparisons that cannot be matched numerically directly

blocks.zh: 整章驗證參數彼此環環相扣、大量共用數據——體現 TR 33「以科學論證與統計嚴謹性為核心、避免重複過度測試」的整體設計哲學
blocks.en: The validation parameters throughout the chapter are closely interlinked and share a great deal of data, reflecting the overall design philosophy of TR 33: "centered on scientific justification and statistical rigor, avoiding repeated and excessive testing"
